**Remaining path after 1.0 cut — the 1.1 roadmap**

What: The remaining path after the 1.0 cut (the 1.1 line). Recorded on owner's request ("dejemos registrado el camino que falta"). Full plan: docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md + epic #313.
After tag v1.0.0 (controlled pilot), the 1.1 line runs the epic in this order:
- M2 — decoupling reaches the user: #123 (day:start uses configured harness + drop personal remote), #315 (dedup byte-identical hook compiler + equality test), #316 (unify the 4 .env parsers).
- M3 — reviewer = real code-review (the moat): #317 (CRITICAL — prReviews returns no body -> priorVerdicts always empty -> anti-loop/rev-bound/board inert; refuter dead code; findings no round-trip; self-review off in default), plus inline per-line comments (brain-review/2 comments[], GitLab discussions parity, stays event:COMMENT per ADR-0020), plus #284. Consider a reviewer PANEL mode (dual-blind consensus, borrowed from judgment-day).
- M4 — distribution + self-update to product bar. THE HARD GATE BEFORE EXTERNAL ADOPTION = auto-update-safety: rollback/atomic-write (U4), plain-copy clobber asymmetry .gemini/CODEOWNERS/AGENTS.md/workflows (U3), corrupt-file soft-lockout (U6), silent downgrade schemaVersion ratchet (U5), discoverable --abort-on-collision (U7), danger-path e2e (U9). Distribution (defer-friendly): npx brain init / bin / postinstall (kill manual package.json edit), registry/mirror decision, i18n leak bootstrap.sh:226, brain:adopt S2 (--apply/migrate/reconcile).
- M5 — role-as-port (C): #312 + ratify ADR-0023 (draft in brain-drafts/) + roles/ module + gentle-ai/plain providers + parity test.
- M8 — per-stage SDD engine routing (stage->engine map): supersedes ADR-0019; depends on M5.
- M6 — provider parity: #130 (GitLab rung-2/3), #124 (human approval signature), #131 (diff-size excludes test lines), #129 (project-status generic).
- M7 — backlog & scope: #268, #280 (brain:status), #263, #256, #247, #117 (close/defer — scope creep), test brain-to-engram (D4), dual schemaVersion namespaces (DR4), close #217/#222.
- M0 housekeeping (do anytime): close #217/#222, #314 (dup 267 dir), .gitignore .memory/chunks.
Premise scorecard reminder (avg ~63%): weakest = SDD stage-config (M8) and reviewer (M3/#317); tokens unmeasured (Track G brain:metrics, unbuilt). Strong = memory, evolutive-memory-in-repo, VCS.
Related: [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]] [[architecture/release-strategy-1.0]] [[review/priorverdicts-inert-bug]] [[architecture/per-stage-engine-routing]].
